name: Neeraj Varma
player_statement:
A complete player, Neeraj Varma has made a big mark in cricket. With 66 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 28*, with an average of 7.90 and a quick strike rate of 111.58. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 13 sixes and 39 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 135.2 overs, taking 50 wickets at an economy rate of 9.23. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
